new.name: REPORTS_UNAVAILABLE_ENVIRONMENT_TOOL
new.definition: The observation states that an assumed command-line utility or executable is absent from the environment, revealing a missing dependency rather than a defect in the artifact being built.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The tool result announcing the unavailability of the utility.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains an unavailability message for a named executable (for example a 'command not found' style result).
The missing entity is an external tool or binary invoked by the agent, not the agent's own source file.
exclusion_conditions: The error arises from incorrect arguments passed to a utility that is in fact installed.
The error arises from a defect in the agent-authored script executed by an available interpreter.

new.name: SUMMARIZES_OBSERVATION_OUTCOME
new.definition: The reasoning restates and condenses the concrete outcome reported by a specific preceding observation, characterizing it as success, as an environment state, or as a partially successful result.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text carrying the restatement of the result.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior tool result whose outcome is being restated.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning content corresponds traceably to the specific prior observation, repeating its result (for example downloaded state, returned status codes, pass/fail verdicts).
The restatement may classify a mixed result, distinguishing which checks passed from those that failed.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only proposes future steps without characterizing a prior result.
The reasoning is merely topically related to the observation without restating its outcome.

new.name: DERIVES_NEXT_ACTION_FROM_OBSERVATION
new.definition: The reasoning adopts a concrete next action because of a finding in a prior observation, using that finding as the stated basis for the choice.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that selects an approach in light of the observation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior tool result supplying the deciding information.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly links a specific finding of the observation (available packages, missing utility, error cause, test result) to the concrete step it decides to take.
The decided step would plausibly differ had the observation reported a different finding.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning restates the result without using it to select a step.
The chosen step was already fixed before the observation and is not justified by it.

new.name: DELIBERATES_ON_AMBIGUOUS_REQUIREMENT
new.definition: The reasoning identifies a requirement detail that admits multiple readings and weighs competing interpretations before committing to one behavior.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text containing the interpretative deliberation.

assertion_conditions: At least one under-specified requirement detail is explicitly called out as ambiguous.
At least two candidate behaviors are considered, with a rationale for the one finally adopted.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely lists implementation steps for an unambiguous requirement.
The reasoning states an assumption without weighing alternatives.

new.name: CREATES_FILE_ARTIFACT
new.definition: The action persists content at a named filesystem path, producing a durable artifact such as a source file or script that later steps can execute, import, or serve.
assertion_conditions: The invocation supplies both the content to persist and the target path where it is written.
The persisted artifact is intended for later use in the workflow rather than discarded immediately.
exclusion_conditions: The content is passed inline to an interpreter and no durable file artifact is produced.
The invocation only reads, lists, or inspects existing paths.
The invocation is rejected before any content is written.

new.name: EXECUTES_PREVIOUSLY_CREATED_ARTIFACT
new.definition: The action runs the filesystem artifact produced by an earlier file-creating action, so the execution depends on that earlier artifact's content.

parameters.name: execution_action
parameters.description: The action that invokes the artifact.

parameters.name: creation_action
parameters.description: The earlier action that wrote the artifact to its path.

assertion_conditions: The creation action precedes the execution action and writes to a specific path.
The execution command references that same path, so the executed content is the artifact produced by the creation action.
exclusion_conditions: The executed file was produced by some other means than the creation action.
The later action only inspects or edits the artifact without running it.

new.name: LAUNCHES_DETACHED_LONG_RUNNING_SERVICE
new.definition: The action starts a long-running server process detached from the invoking shell, with its output redirected, so the process keeps running after the call returns.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The invocation that starts the service in the background.

assertion_conditions: The command detaches the process from the calling shell and redirects its output to a log or equivalent sink.
The invocation reports a process identifier or otherwise acknowledges the detached start.
exclusion_conditions: The server is started in the foreground and blocks the invocation.
The command runs a short-lived operation expected to finish within the call.

new.name: PROBES_DEPLOYED_SERVICE_ENDPOINT
new.definition: The action sends crafted requests to the HTTP endpoint of an already running service, and the resulting observation records the returned status codes and response bodies for those requests.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action issuing the requests to the live endpoint.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The tool result recording the returned statuses and payloads.

assertion_conditions: The requests target the deployed service over the network rather than importing its code in-process.
The payloads are constructed to represent scenarios of interest, including valid inputs and invalid-input cases intended to produce error statuses.
The observation reports the returned status code and body for the issued requests.
exclusion_conditions: The action only starts or inspects the process without sending requests.
The invocation fails before any request reaches the service, so no response is recorded.

new.name: VERIFIES_REACHABILITY_VIA_EXTERNAL_INTERFACE
new.definition: The action addresses the deployed service through a non-loopback network address, and the observation's successful response confirms that the service is bound to all interfaces rather than localhost only.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action contacting the service through the non-loopback address.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The tool result reporting the response obtained over that address.

assertion_conditions: The request URL or host used by the action is a non-loopback address of the service host.
The observation reports a successful response from that address, establishing that external reachability holds.
exclusion_conditions: The request is sent only to the loopback address, which cannot distinguish all-interfaces binding from localhost-only binding.
The attempt over the non-loopback address fails or returns no response.

new.name: ALLOCATES_EXTENDED_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT
new.definition: The action assigns a deliberately enlarged execution time budget to an invocation that is anticipated to run for a long time, such as a remote artifact download, a first-time model load, or service warm-up.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The invocation carrying the extended time budget.

assertion_conditions: The invocation explicitly sets a time limit larger than the environment default.
The step's expected duration justifies the larger budget, as indicated by its content (bulk download, model loading, warm-up sleep).
exclusion_conditions: The invocation runs at the default time budget for a step expected to complete instantly.
The budget is enlarged without any long-running work in the invoked command.
